scope: Corollary 1.3 (Two-sided first-ionization bound) of the manuscript “Uniform excess charge for Coulomb molecules and the outer radius of neutral atoms” (preprints/Uniform-excess-charge-for-Coulomb-molecules-and-the-outer-radius-of-neutral-atoms-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 263 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5abedb3de1f8ed28), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the full nonrelativistic Coulomb atom specified above, with integer nuclear charge Z ≥ 1, one-electron kinetic term −∆/2, and two electron spin states, write EZ(n) = E(n, Z). There are universal constants 0 < c ≤ C < ∞ such that the first ionization energy of the neutral atom satisfies c ≤ I1(Z) := EZ(Z − 1) − EZ(Z) ≤ C for every integer Z ≥ 1.
